acceptance_kind: Architecture/dependency boundary expressly requires implementation and dependency review
method: Independent source/dependency review plus retained genuine official Pi RPC/native integration evidence; no rerun

checks.condition: Planning, tool-execution loop and conversational memory belong to external tool
checks.finding: run_pi launches official fixed Pi 1.4.0 executable with --mode rpc and --session; sends get_state/prompt, forwards structured events and waits for agent_settled. Session history is Pi-owned JSONL; Horizon transcript display/storage does not run planning or compaction.

checks.condition: Horizon is an adapter; no direct model API automatic tool loop
checks.finding: Host model provider metadata is written to Pi configuration. Product network call sites were inspected: agent reqwest downloads fixed runtime asset; processes HTTP client probes explicitly configured readiness. No product host/frontend model-generation request is issued.

checks.condition: Host tool wrapper is authorization, not an agent engine
checks.finding: Fixed horizon-policy.ts registers exactly four Pi tools; execute forwards Unix-socket request to host broker and returns text to Pi. Host broker enforces scope/approval and executes only the authorized operation.
capabilities explicitly reports protocol pi-rpc, attach=false, task-only gated tools; fixed-version RPC/native tests invoke real official binary.

limits: This full verdict is only the architectural prohibition REQ-AI-009; it does not close Pi GUI, provider credentials, installer, performance or other functional requirements.
Controlled model fixture supplies deterministic responses; integration evidence is not a live-provider test.
